title: Distinct Gate Paths to LCA
summary: For each query, two people independently ascend from given tree nodes to their LCA with red or blue cards. Each upward edge consumes a choice of one gate instance at its departing node: red/blue gates require and retain that color; white gates accept either and flip it. Parallel gate instances count separately. Count pairs of successful gate sequences modulo 1000000007, treating a person already at the LCA as having one way. Return the bitwise XOR of all query counts. Gates at the destination LCA are not traversed.
